title: PLA Helicopter Crosses Taiwan Strait Median Line for First Time, Lingers in No-Fly Zone
detail: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense detected a PLA helicopter crossing the Taiwan Strait median line between 10:20 a.m. and 7:40 p.m. on July 21, 2026 — the first time a PLA helicopter has been recorded crossing the median line, according to Chieh Chung, a researcher at the government-funded Institute for National Defense and Security Research (INDSR). The aircraft did not simply cross the line but operated for an extended period inside Taiwan's designated no-fly zone on Taiwan's side of the Strait, which analysts characterized as a new form of 'gray-zone' operation. The helicopter was detected alongside a PLA drone during the same window; experts said it remained unclear whether the aircraft originated from a PLA Navy ship or a mainland aviation base. Separately, Taiwan's MND recorded 4 PLA aircraft sorties that day, all 4 crossing the median line into the northern, central and southeastern ADIZ sectors.
